description: Attribution patching on Llama-3.2-1B: every head of every layer at once, at the last position, where head_patching.json patches layers 10 to 12 one head at a time. The base run reads each head's result (`attention_premix`, the output projection's input) and its gradient (`grad`) of the logit difference at the head, in one forward and one backward; the counterfactual run reads the results alone. The counterfactual's result less the base's, times the gradient, summed over the head's dimensions, is each head's first-order estimate of what patching it would do, per pair; `attribution` is its mean over the 42 pairs, `[16 layers, 32 heads]`. Layer 12's head 28 comes first of the 512, at about +2.20, where patching it lifts the logit difference by about +2.46 from the base run's -2.40 (`logit_diff`). Two forwards and one backward, against head_patching.json's 291 forwards for 96 heads.
